LanguageData.PF_BarrenPlanet.label: barren planet
LanguageData.PF_BarrenPlanet.description: A barren body of rock, rubble and regolith, suitable for Mercury-, Mars- and Moon-like surfaces. This preset uses vacuum; atmospheric variants must override both atmosphere and surface environment.
LanguageData.PF_TemperatePlanet.label: temperate planet
LanguageData.PF_TemperatePlanet.description: A rocky body with a relatively mild climate, using native surface generation for oceans, forests, grasslands, deserts and polar regions.
LanguageData.PF_GreenhousePlanet.label: greenhouse planet
LanguageData.PF_GreenhousePlanet.description: A scorching rocky body beneath a dense atmosphere, suitable for Venus-like environments. Explicitly provides heat, high pressure, hypoxia and carbon dioxide toxicity, together with dense cloud appearance.
LanguageData.PF_FrozenPlanet.label: frozen planet
LanguageData.PF_FrozenPlanet.description: A cold body of icy plains and rocky outcrops, suitable for icy moons and icy outer-system bodies. This preset uses a vacuum surface; subsurface oceans require extension capabilities.
LanguageData.PF_GasGiant.label: gas giant
LanguageData.PF_GasGiant.description: A body with a massive gaseous envelope, suitable for Jupiter- and Saturn-like planets. Provides gravity, atmosphere and cloud appearance, with no conventional landing, surface layer or colony maps.
LanguageData.PF_IceGiant.label: ice giant
LanguageData.PF_IceGiant.description: A giant rich in volatiles such as water, ammonia and methane, suitable for Uranus- and Neptune-like bodies. The name describes composition and does not imply a landable ice surface.
